column1: # Every user property that sets a parameter of a goal the Airness parents bind, one row per plugin and
# property: the plugin's artifact identifier, the property, and who owns it.
# RESERVED: a child project file may not declare it, because it decides what a check reads or concludes.
# PROJECT: a child may declare it. Only a plugin a child may configure carries such a row; every property
# of a plugin Airness supplies is RESERVED, since the child cannot configure that plugin any other way.
# PluginPropertiesTest derives the rows from the pinned plugin descriptors and the parents' bindings, and
# fails on a missing or stale row, so a parameter a plugin upgrade adds is classified here before it ships.
